items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I played at the Mount Airy Lodge with Bob Newman’s band for a year

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I’m on most of them. Been into like a wordy phase lately. Using bigger words, I don’t know why. It’s a synoli of some kind. But yeah with doing that, and I was doing quite a bit of other recordings, some jazz recordings, and I played a lot with — well I played at the Mount Airy Lodge with Bob Newman’s band for a year, after I left Gary, and that’s where I met Steve Gilmore who later was the bass player with Phil. I introduced them. So I loved playing with Steve, and we had a really great band at Mount…
